title: 1 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 Corinthians 4: stewards of God's mysteries, judging nothing before the time, the hardships of the apostles, and the sending of Timothy.

questions.text: How does verse 1 say a man should think of the writer and those with him?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says to think of them as Christ's servants and stewards of God's mysteries.

answers.text: As judges appointed over the whole assembly
As Christ's servants and stewards of God's mysteries
As teachers of the law of Moses and the prophets
As fathers of all the Gentile assemblies

questions.text: According to verse 2, what is required of stewards?
questions.explanation: The verse says it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

questions.text: Until when does verse 5 say they should judge nothing?
questions.explanation: It says to judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will bring to light the hidden things of darkness.

questions.text: What does verse 7 say about everything they have?
questions.explanation: The verse asks what they have that they did not receive, and why they boast as if they had not received it.

answers.text: They will lose all of it

questions.text: How does verse 9 say God has displayed the apostles?
questions.explanation: It says God has displayed the apostles last of all, like men sentenced to death, made a spectacle to the world, to angels and men.

answers.text: First of all, like rulers of cities
Quietly, like servants in a house
Last of all, like men sentenced to death

questions.text: Which hardships does verse 11 list as going on to that present hour?
questions.explanation: The verse says they hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

answers.text: Hunger, thirst, nakedness, beatings and no certain dwelling place
Imprisonment, shipwreck and the loss of all their goods
Sickness, poverty, loneliness and the scorn of their friends
Fear, doubt, sleeplessness and quarrels among themselves

questions.text: According to verse 12, what do they do when people curse them?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when people curse them, they bless, and being persecuted, they endure.

questions.text: What does verse 15 say about tutors and fathers?
questions.explanation: It says that though they have ten thousand tutors in Christ, they do not have many fathers, and that in Christ Jesus he became their father through the Good News.

answers.text: They have many fathers but no tutors
They have many tutors but not many fathers
They have neither tutors nor fathers
They have one tutor and ten thousand fathers

questions.text: Whom does the writer say he has sent to the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says he has sent Timothy, his beloved and faithful child in the Lord, to remind them of his ways in Christ.

questions.text: According to verse 20, God's Kingdom is not in word, but in what?
questions.explanation: The verse says God's Kingdom is not in word, but in power.
